datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Malawi administrative areas. The spatial data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases for 2022, with classifications standardized according to the IPC scale and stored as geographic features with temporal metadata.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to classify acute food insecurity levels across geographic areas.
